components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Teal pill for the main action.

narrative.overview: An engineer's working notebook: warm cream paper, a deep teal pen, hairline rules, and the occasional coral or gold mark in the margin. Sections are full-screen pages that stack over each other as the visitor scrolls, each one a new leaf. The tone is plain and factual, and the interface lets the work lead.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper ground, never pure white or dark (except the Home System page).
One typeface, Outfit, with heavy headlines and small tracked uppercase labels.
Section pages stack with scroll snap; each lifts over the previous with an upward shadow.
Pill buttons, large rounded glass cards.
Hairline rules separate list rows instead of boxes.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only interactive color. Coral and gold appear as accents, never as buttons or links.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds are cream or card paper. No pure white page, no gray.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Do not add a second typeface; hierarchy comes from weight, size, and tracking.

rules.name: The Stack Rule
rules.body: Depth means this page sits over the previous one. Do not add shadows to decorate flat elements.

dos: Do use Teal Ink (#14635a) for every interactive element.
Do put tracked uppercase teal labels above headline titles.
Do separate list items with hairline rules.
Do keep copy plain and factual; respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Do check contrast on Teal Glow, coral, and gold before using them for text.
donts: Don't use indigo (currently in the Navbar); it is legacy drift from teal.
Don't add a second font family.
Don't use pure white or gray page backgrounds.
Don't add testimonials, metrics, or imagery that implies proof that does not exist.
Don't remove or flatten the Pokedex, StackCard, or Hero orbit.
